Nones (Auden) | Nones is a book of poems by W. H. Auden published in 1951 by Faber & Faber.  The book contains Auden's shorter poems written between 1946 and 1950, including "In Praise of Limestone", "Prime", "Nones," "Memorial for the City", "Precious Five", and "A Walk After Dark".
2nd II None (album) | 2nd II None is the self-titled debut album from Compton hip hop duo 2nd II None.  The album was released on October 8, 1991 under Profile Records and it would be entirely produced by DJ Quik.
